primary.title: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would

primary.title: Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds
primary.summary: A study by Vals AI tested 25 AI models for alignment with Chinese government positions and found surprising results. Chinese models respond to political questions less uniformly than expected, and Western models occasionally adopt official Beijing positions too. The language of the prompt had an especially strong effect on the political slant of responses. The article Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds appeared first on The Decoder.
